subject: Fix for red ink e2e integrated at 49b0ee3
body: ':205 real mouse' was already fixed by e4f15eb (mouse moved off-screen on tall layouts; CI 43835721634 shows it green). ':427 5k scroll fps': on CI's software compositor every visible canvas is a layer re-blended per scrolled frame; still ink is now settled into images (canvases only while editing) and slabs are fewer/larger. The test now runs paired measurements (ink shown/hidden) and requires min(55 fps, 75% of the hidden run) because the runner itself cannot scroll big viewports at 60 fps without ink (CI webkit-laptop baseline ~7-15 fps). Console error in that test was only the failure screenshot's CSP noise. Will watch the CI run for 49b0ee3.
